static.draftNotice: This text is a draft pending legal review. It is not final.
static.aboutP1: Circular2Action helps people in Bangladesh find job, scholarship and internship circulars, understand whether they qualify, and keep track of every deadline.
static.aboutP2: Each opportunity links to its official circular. We do not apply on your behalf and we never ask for payments.
static.privacyP1: We collect only what we need to run your account and show you relevant opportunities: your email, name and the profile details you choose to add.
static.privacyP2: Your profile is used only to check eligibility for you. You can export or delete your data at any time from Settings.
static.termsP1: Circular2Action is a guide. Opportunity details come from official circulars and may change. Always confirm with the official circular before you apply.
static.termsP2: You must be 18 or older to create an account. Do not share your password.
static.helpQ1: How do I check if I qualify?
static.helpA1: Open an opportunity and choose “Check my eligibility”. Add your details in your profile for a personal result.
static.helpQ2: Why does a result say “needs verification”?
static.helpA2: Some requirements could not be confirmed against the official circular yet. Check the circular itself.
static.helpQ3: How do I stop tracking an application?
static.helpA3: Open it in the tracker and choose “Stop tracking”.

home2.heroTitle: Your next opportunity, found for you
home2.heroLead: Jobs, internships and scholarships from official circulars, matched to you rule by rule. Apply, track and never miss a deadline.
home2.featureTitle: Everything for your search, in one place
home2.f1Text: See which conditions you meet and what is missing, before you apply.
home2.f2Text: Set your interests and the list gets better with what you view and save. You stay in control.
home2.f3Text: New matches and closing deadlines reach you in the app. No flood, no noise.
home2.f4Text: Apply on the site, get a tracking ID and follow every step. Or track applications you make elsewhere.
home2.f5Text: Open job feeds collected for you, clearly marked as not verified.
home2.f6Text: Every page in both languages, made for phones as much as computers.
home2.a1: Yes. Browsing, eligibility checks, suggestions, alerts and tracking are free.
home2.a2: Staff check opportunities against the official circular before publishing. Jobs from the web are collected automatically and are clearly marked as not verified.
home2.q3: Do you send my application to the employer?
home2.a3: No. Applying on the site records your application and gives you a tracking ID for our reviewers. Use the official link when the circular asks for it.
home2.q4: What do you do with my activity?
home2.a4: It is used only to suggest opportunities to you. You can switch it off or clear it at any time, and staff never see it.
